title: Farmslot Recipe Suite Result v1
description: A fail-closed resolution for every case in an immutable recipe suite scope.

$schema.description: Canonical Recipe Suite Result v1 schema URL.

suite_id.description: Suite identifier copied from the frozen scope.

scope_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical frozen scope document.

totals.description: Derived counts that must reconcile with the scope and resolutions.

resolutions.description: Exactly one verdict or explicit non-execution record per declared case.

declared.description: Number of cases in the frozen scope.

executed.description: Number of cases resolved by retained recipe-run summaries.

not_executed.description: Number of cases carrying explicit non-execution records.

id.description: Declared case identifier this verdict resolves.

kind.description: Marks a case resolved by a completed recipe run.

status.description: Terminal status copied from the retained summary.

summary_path.description: Safe relative path to the retained summary in the suite package.

summary_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical retained summary document.

id.description: Declared case identifier that was not executed.

kind.description: Marks a case resolved by an explicit non-execution reason.

reason_class.description: Machine-readable reason the case did not execute.

detail.description: Specific explanation for this non-execution decision.

blocked_by.description: Declared case IDs blocking an ordering-dependent case.
